question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word:

 CONTINUOUS
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Sporadic)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Continuous"** means something that occurs without interruption, happening constantly or without any break. (निरंतर)
 
 
• **Example:** The continuous rainfall flooded the streets of the city.
 
 
 
• **"Sporadic" **refers to something that occurs at irregular intervals or happens occasionally, not continuous or steady. (छिटपुट)
 
 
• **Example:** The power cuts in the village were sporadic, happening only a few times a week.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'continuous' **is **'sporadic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Sporadic)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Constant** (स्थिर): Something that occurs continuously over a period of time or does not change.
 
 
• **Example:** The constant support of my friends helped me overcome my challenges.
 
 
 
• **Perpetual** (सदैव): Never ending or changing, lasting forever.
 
 
• **Example:** The perpetual noise from the construction site annoyed the residents.
 
 
 
• **Unending** (अंतहीन): Something that seems to have no end or continues indefinitely.
 
 
• **Example:** The unending road made the journey seem longer than it actually was.
